source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 273 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 273.

PD 273.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 273 was established by Ordinance No. 19613, passed by the Dallas City Council on July 29, 1987. Ordinance No. 19613 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 19613 was amended by Ordinance No. 23973, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 11, 1999. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19613; 23973; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 273 is established on property generally located along the northwest line of Ferguson Road, northeast of the northeast line of Highland Road. The size of PD 273 is approximately 5.69 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must conform to the development plan (Exhibit 273A). (Ord. Nos. 19613; 23973; 25711)

sections.title: Landscaping And Trees
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.105. LANDSCAPING AND TREES.

(a) Landscaping of the Property must conform to the landscape plan (Exhibit 273B). A continuous landscaped buffer strip of a minimum two feet in width must be provided between the side boundary lines of the Property and the screening fence, as shown on the landscape plan. All landscaping must be installed within six months of the date of issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times.

(b) All existing trees with a minimum caliper of six inches along the eastern and western boundaries of the site as identified on the landscape plan must be retained. Any existing tree along the eastern or western boundary of the site that dies or is removed or destroyed must be replaced with a comparable tree or with photinia shrubs to accomplish the screening and buffer function contemplated by the landscape plan. The three existing pecan trees adjacent to the proposed Valley Glen Drive frontage as shown on the drawing labelled as “Landscape Plan - Section 2” must be retained or replaced with a comparable tree if destroyed or if they die of natural causes. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Permitted Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.106. PERMITTED USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are as follows:

(1) Mini-warehouse.

(2) Outside storage of recreational vehicles, boats, and cars. [The outside storage of recreational vehicles, boats, and cars is prohibited once the mini-warehouse buildings are constructed in Phase III as shown on the development plan.] (Ord. Nos. 23973; 25711)

sections.title: Caretaker’S Quarters
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.107. CARETAKER’S QUARTERS.

A caretaker’s quarters associated with the mini-warehouse use is permitted on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.108. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Maximum permitted floor area is 102,375 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.109. SETBACKS.

A minimum front yard setback of 15 feet must be provided on the Property. A minimum side yard setback of 20 feet must be provided on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.110. MAXIMUM COVERAGE.

Lot coverage of the Property may not exceed 45 percent. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Maximum Permitted Height
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.111. MAXIMUM PERMITTED HEIGHT.

No structure on the Property may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.112. OFF-STREET PARKING.

A minimum of 34 parking spaces must be provided for the mini-warehouse use. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Access
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.113. ACCESS.

The owner shall install a gate, as approved by the director of public works and transportation and the fire marshall, to prohibit all vehicular traffic except emergency vehicles from accessing the Property from Valley Glen Drive. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Elevations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.114. ELEVATIONS.

Development of the Property must conform to the elevation plan (Exhibit 273C). (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.115. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Chapter 51. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.116. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must be in compliance with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.117. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.118. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-273.119. ZONING MAP.

PD 273 is located on Zoning Map No. I-9. (Ord. Nos. 19613; 25711)
